about: The proof kit's reads of V3 state at one block B that GrandpaLightClient #2 on Sepolia imported: B's header and its parent (a checkpoint in the set that signs B), grandpa_proveFinality(B) with the set and the signers hint, what the light client answers for B, and under B's state root the main-trie reads PortaldotState makes (System.Account, Assets.Account, Nfts.Item, Revive.AccountInfoOf, present and absent) and the vault's slots in its child trie, each proof walked from the root with every item used, and the tampers.

reads.name: System.Account of the deployer 0xD983…1071 (its EVM account)
System.Account of the owner's wallet 0xc6e9…2011 (its EVM account)
Assets.Account of asset 7777 for 0x4f7d…df25: 0.1 pUSD, below the example gate's minimum
Assets.Account of asset 7777 for the Substrate account 0xfc5b…d636: a 66-byte DepositFrom value, behind its hash (trie V1)
Assets.Account of asset 4601 for 0x0a90…bc49: a Frozen balance
Assets.Account of asset 7777 for the deployer: absent
The Assets.Account prefix of asset 7777: a branch without a value
Nfts.Item(10, 3163806249): an item owned by an EVM account
Nfts.Item(0, 0): an item owned by a Substrate account
Revive.AccountInfoOf of the vault 0xa02E…8ffd: a Contract entry
Revive.AccountInfoOf of 0x0000…0001: an externally owned account's entry

read 3's proof for the deployer, who holds no asset 7777
read 3's proof for the same holder in asset 4601

read 11's proof for the same item number in collection 0

notes: B is V3 #264,729, which carries the change from set 73 to set 74: set 73 finalized it, and Grandpa.CurrentSetId is 74 at B. GrandpaLightClient #2 on Sepolia imported it with importHeader in 0xc4838f472710564b5ba7d04540e2dace9d25c7c4c65637500b7e3a3e72aeb13e (block 12,032,770); a fresh client initialized at set 73 with B's parent as the checkpoint imports it with this finality proof.

Every read is made the way PortaldotState makes it: the light client's state root of B, then the walk of StorageProofs.verifyMain, then the decoder. outcome is what the contracts do with it: value, or the error they revert with. KeyNotPresent is a proof that the key holds nothing; EmptyValue a key that ends on a branch without a value.
An EVM account's id on V3 is its 20-byte address followed by 12 bytes of 0xEE (pallet-revive's AccountId32Mapper); a Substrate account keeps its own 32-byte id.
The asset holders and NFT owners other than the project's own accounts are public V3 chain data, read only: no transaction names them.

state_getReadProof's items are kept in the order the node served them. Every item is used by the walk; any item flipped fails with "Incomplete Proof!". For each slot, served.mainTrieItems counts the items of state_getChildReadProof that are exactly the child-root proof's.

The decoders are V3's runtime layout (portaldot-v3 3002, trie V1): an 80-byte AccountInfo, AssetAccount of 18, 34 or 66 bytes by its reason, an Nfts ItemDetails parsed whole, a 130-byte Revive Contract entry.
